task.question: In the 2026 FIFA World Cup, what format was used for the knockout stage starting June 28?
task.evidence: The knockout stage used a single-elimination format, starting with the newly introduced round of 32 on June 28 and culminating with the final on July 19, with a match for third place the day before. If the score was even after regulation time in a match, 30 minutes of extra time were added. If still tied after this, a penalty shootout determined the winner.
task.sonnet_answer: The Round of 32 knockout stage began on June 28, 2026, as the expanded 48-team tournament introduced a Round of 32 for the first time in World Cup history.
